title: The Song You Said You Wrote
youtube_title: The Song You Said You Wrote | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Honest words let a friend help with the repair.
summary: At a library table by the round window, Kito is tangled up with a tune you said you wrote, though you had heard it next door and almost hides it. Kito tells Miss Dalca the plain truth, and together they mend what can be mended, with no teasing.
